card.name: Second digit after a leading 2
card.fires_on: A single digit that follows the digit 2 inside a number, such as the 4 in 2.4 or 2<<6>>. It appears in DOI strings, Bible chapter references and model numbers.

modes.label: DOI numbers
modes.description: A digit after 2 in the prefix of a DOI, such as 10.2x.

modes.label: Bible chapter numbers
modes.description: The second digit of a chapter in the 20s, in a scripture citation.

modes.label: Other numbers
modes.description: A digit after 2 in a model name or a count.

card.plain: It fires on the second digit of a number that starts with 2, mostly in DOIs and Bible verse references.
